purpose: Acquire the official Open Images V6 visual-relationship annotations needed to audit a real-image object-attribute routing pilot over the already admitted 25,000-image Stage-A subset.
required_gates_before_any_training_proto: all source byte sizes and MD5 hashes match
source SHA-256 hashes are recorded after acquisition
existing image manifest and human-audit hashes match
image-atomic train, selection-development, and sealed-confirmation partitions are frozen
only RelationLabel-equivalent actual field RelationshipLabel equals is for attribute examples
all normalized boxes are valid and survive a minimum visible-area rule at 224 pixels
same-box conflicting labels within a mutually exclusive attribute family are excluded
source-target exchange pairs use the same object class and different attributes within one family
same-attribute no-op and random-source controls are generated
a train-only stratified contact sheet passes human review
NaturalBench examples and outcomes are not used for data filtering, prompt selection, checkpoint selection, or training
claim_boundary: This admission authorizes a bounded annotation download and audit only. It does not authorize parameter updates or establish data quality, method novelty, natural-image transfer, release rights, or model superiority.
